observes: F-C1303 reproduced on the pin: ledger of 30 revisions of tenant zeta then 3 of tenant acme (9 records), acme erased; 60 calls of Graph.KG.LedgerRedact.Redact('', 'acme', '|', ..., batch 1, max_batches 1) each scanned the first 20 records (batch x SCANFACTOR) from the start of the ledger, tombstoned 0 and returned complete=false; 9 acme records remain. Control: the same world with max_batches 0 completes in one call (9 tombstoned, 14 batches). Contradicts LedgerRedact.cls:178-180 'running the same target again resumes it'.
